messages.subject: Hierarchical subject metadataSpeciesTag not found and problems with digikam
parts:
Hello camtrapR users and Juergen,

I'm getting to grips with camtrapR for a very large data set. I tagged all my photos in DigiKam according to the hierarchical structure required. We run the script with another set of photos and it works but with this particular database  I get the following error:}

"Warning: Estacion 1_100_BTCF:   metadataSpeciesTag 'Mamíferos' not found in image metadata tag 'HierarchicalSubject'"

I look into the file's properties in DigiKam and I found that in "properties/ digiKam properties", in the working database, the tags are arranged with the following structure:



The "not working" database is arranged with the following structure:



I tagged both databases the same and can't figure out what is the problem and ran the same codes in R with camtrapR

metadata_table <- recordTable(inDir  = wd_images,
                              cameraID = "directory",
                              camerasIndependent = FALSE,
                              IDfrom = "metadata",
                              metadataSpeciesTag =  "Mamíferos", 
                              metadataHierarchyDelimitor = "|")
